subject: Urgent: Consortium 'Gold' procurement — per-tenant audit streaming & residency guarantee
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@consortiumfinance.com>

Cc: Sofia Vega <svega@consortiumfinance.com>

Subject: Consortium 'Gold' requirements (audit streaming + residency)

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Consortium is close to selecting a vendor for our "Gold" tier and we want to confirm two procurement-blocker requirements before we go to legal:

1) Per-tenant continuous audit stream (SSE / signed events) exported to our SIEM (ELK) with 7-year retention. We need a live export that includes metadata and redaction markers.

2) Residency guarantee: all inference and ephemeral caches must be confined to our EU VPC and backed by customer-managed KMS keys.

Attached is an updated requirements doc (consortium_requirements_v2.pdf) with examples. Our procurement timeline is tight — final vendor decision targeted by 2026-09-20. If these are non-starters or need product changes, please let us know ASAP because procurement will request a gating plan.

— Liam

Ask: can Product/Eng provide a realistic path (MVP scope + ETA) we can present to procurement by EOW (09/17)? Procurement will push for the guarantees as conditions of the contract; Marissa and I are prepared to offer commercial concessions if we can land a technical sprint.

Quick context: Consortium is a large EU bank, likely to sign a 3-year committed capacity deal for Redwood Dedicated if we can satisfy these controls. Deal ID attached above.

Requested owners: Jordan — rough technical feasibility and minimal implementation plan. Monica — outline CS support and pilot onboarding. Marcus — product tradeoffs / prioritization guidance.

Thanks,

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Consortium 'Gold' requirements (audit streaming + residency)

Karthik — thanks for the ping and the doc. Quick technical read:

- Per-tenant audit stream: feasible as an MVP if we surface an export pipeline from the request router that emits structured events (request metadata + redaction markers) to a tenant-owned endpoint or an intermediary Kinesis/HTTPS forwarder. We'll need ~2-3 weeks of concentrated eng work to add a streaming sink, plus another week for hardened signing and schema/versioning.

- Residency + CMEK: Dedicated already supports VPC + CMK for customer data at rest in our Dedicated model, but two gap areas: (1) KV cache residency — currently caches may persist on worker nodes; we'd need a residency-lock that pins KV stores to tenant-only hosts and attaches CMK encryption for ephemeral cache dumps, (2) runtime attestation/operational proof — procurement wants an auditable guarantee. Implementing the residency-lock (scheduling affinity + eviction policies) is ~3-4 weeks. Audit evidence (reporting/policies) adds another week.

Risk/Tradeoffs: the residency-lock increases scheduling complexity and reduces overall capacity sharing (cost impact). The audit-streaming MVP can be scoped to "events only" initially (no payloads) to reduce PII risk and unblock procurement; later we can add payload forwarding with redaction hooks.

Proposed minimal plan to present:
1) Audit stream (events-only): 3 weeks dev + 1 week QA
2) Residency-lock (scheduling + CMK): 4 weeks dev + 1 week QA
3) Audit evidence package & SOW language: 1 week (CS + Security)

Total ramp for MVP end-to-end: ~8–9 weeks if prioritized. If we split into parallel workstreams (audit stream + residency), could shave 2 weeks.

I can put together a short tech note for procurement and a rollout canary plan. Need Product to confirm prioritization and whether this displaces current roadmap work.

— Jordan
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Consortium 'Gold' requirements (audit streaming + residency)

Folks — appreciate the fast read, Jordan. Consortium is pushing procurement hard; they made clear to Liam that "this is a binary ask" for the Gold selection. A few commercial notes to help prioritization:

- Consortium is targeting a multi-year, committed Dedicated contract with an ARR north of $2M in year 1. They are willing to sign contingent SOW / milestone-based acceptance if we can provide a clear gating plan and acceptance criteria.

- I am prepared to offer an accelerated implementation credit (one-quarter service credit) if Product/Eng can commit to an MVP delivery calendar we can put into the SOW.

Operational ask to Product: can we commit to the parallel workstream approach Jordan suggested? If Product cannot prioritize immediately, we should propose a compromise product + commercial path:
  * Short-term compromise: deliver audit-stream events-only (no payloads) + signed residency attestation and a formal SOW clause promising residency-lock delivery within 9 weeks after contract signature.

Monica — please prep a pilot readiness checklist and onboarding resources; procurement will want to see how we gate the pilot and acceptance tests.

Marcus — we need product to triage this against the next two sprints. Please advise (a) whether this can be T-shirt-sized as "P1 sprint" and (b) which planned work items it would displace.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Consortium 'Gold' requirements — request for prioritization & ETA

Marcus / Product team —

Following up to ask for a firm prioritization decision. Marissa has offered a commercial acceleration credit and Consortium is prepared to sign pending the SOW with milestone dates. Jordan's breakdown suggests a ~8–9 week MVP if fully prioritized or ~6 weeks if parallelized. Procurement needs a binding acceptance criteria and a delivery milestone for the SOW.

Please reply with one of the following by EOD tomorrow (09/16):
1) Commit to parallel workstreams with target delivery "audit-stream (events-only) + residency attestation" in 6 weeks and full residency-lock in 9 weeks, OR
2) Decline prioritization now and provide exact roadmap slot / earliest sprint start we can offer, OR
3) Propose an alternate technical/commercial compromise we can present to procurement.

I'll draft the SOW language once Product confirms scope and dates. HubSpot and the DocuSign link are attached above — procurement will expect the dates in the SOW.

Thanks — urgent on this one.
